mapper.select: SELECT id, apply_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, apply_quantity, price, total_price, remark, create_time, update_time FROM asset_purchase_apply_detail WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, apply_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, apply_quantity, price, total_price, remark, create_time, update_time FROM asset_purchase_apply_detail WHERE apply_id = #{applyId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_purchase_apply_detail (apply_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, apply_quantity, price, total_price, remark) VALUES (#{applyId}, #{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{spec}, #{manufacturer}, #{unit}, #{applyQuantity}, #{price}, #{totalPrice}, #{remark})

INSERT INTO asset_purchase_apply_detail (apply_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, apply_quantity, price, total_price, remark) VALUES
(#{item.applyId}, #{item.assetCode}, #{item.assetName}, #{item.spec}, #{item.manufacturer}, #{item.unit}, #{item.applyQuantity}, #{item.price}, #{item.totalPrice}, #{item.remark})
